messages.subject: Crossfield — the housing problem
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, I'm formally asking Whitfield Carter to act for us on the Crossfield matter. As you know we've now confirmed through the lab that the housings were the wrong steel grade and the cost to us is well into seven figures. The board wants this pursued properly but also wants to keep an eye on spend.

Could you send through your engagement terms and an estimate for the first phase? Henry Doyle (Operations) will be your main technical contact.

Thanks,
Grace

--
Pennington Industries Limited
14 Faraday Court, Aston, Birmingham B7 4AA

messages.snippet: Dear Grace, Thank you — we're very glad to act. I attach our engagement letter and terms of business
messages.subject: RE: Crossfield — the housing problem
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

Thank you — we're very glad to act. I attach our engagement letter and terms of business. James Osei (copied) will run the matter day to day and Tom Gallagher will support; I'll supervise throughout.

Our estimate for the pre-action phase (review, Letter Before Action and advice on merits) is £28,000–£38,000 plus VAT and disbursements. We'll firm that up after reviewing the agreement and the Wraysbury report. Please could you sign and return the enclosed copy, and we'll get moving on the Letter Before Action.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
DX 138760 Cheapside | +44 (0)20 7946 0991
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
